m1.typescript: m1 the marketplace file names an owner and lists each plugin by a source that resolves

e1.typescript: e1 names are valid in a plugin id and are not reserved or mistaken for official ones

e2.typescript: e2 the plugin keeps only its manifest in the manifest folder and finds its files through the plugin root

e3.typescript: e3 the version lives in the manifest alone and is semantic

e4.typescript: e4 each source kind is written in its own form and pinned to a tag and a commit

e5.typescript: e5 a dependency carries a range and one from another marketplace is allowed by name

e6.typescript: e6 the team settings register the marketplace and enable only what installs from it

e7.typescript: e7 renames lead every former name to a current plugin or to null

e8.typescript: e8 no file is left unfinished or holds a personal path an address or a key

wrong-entry-name-mismatch.defect: lists the plugin under a name that differs from the name in its own manifest

wrong-dotdot-source.defect: writes the relative source with .. so that it leaves the marketplace

wrong-reserved-marketplace-name.defect: calls the marketplace by an official Anthropic marketplace name

wrong-official-plugin-name.defect: lists a fourth plugin whose name passes as an official one

wrong-hooks-without-wrapper.defect: writes the event map without the top-level hooks key, so the file fails to load

wrong-hook-script-path.defect: finds the guard script by a path relative to the working directory instead of the plugin root

wrong-version-in-both.defect: sets the version in the manifest and again in the marketplace entry

wrong-version-not-semver.defect: gives the plugin a two-part version

wrong-short-sha.defect: pins a github source to an abbreviated commit

wrong-url-shorthand.defect: writes a url source with the owner/repo shorthand that only a github source takes

wrong-no-pin.defect: leaves a git-subdir source without a commit pin

wrong-dependency-unconstrained.defect: depends on lint-helper with no version range

wrong-cross-marketplace-no-allowlist.defect: depends on a plugin of another marketplace without allowing that marketplace

wrong-settings-key-mismatch.defect: registers the marketplace in the team settings under a name that its file does not carry

wrong-enable-external-plugin.defect: enables a plugin from an external source, which the repository settings alone do not install

wrong-rename-dangling.defect: renames a former plugin to a name that no entry has

wrong-personal-path.defect: puts a home-folder path in the marketplace description
